description: Byte-budget vectors for wire-v0 section 6: the decoded bytes of every string and bytes value (including literals, enum members and dictionary, grammar and derived values) against min(maxTotalBytes, maxByteAmplification x (body length + 1)), just at and just past the bound, under the default limits unless a vector carries `limits` (merged over the defaults). Hex is body bytes only. `plan` selects row@1 or columnar@5; an optional `profile` has the same shape as the profiled vectors in columnar.json. Values of the form {"$bytes": "<hex>"} denote a bytes value. `valid` vectors round-trip; `invalidDecode` and `invalidEncode` fail with `error`. `packedDecode` vectors decode `hex` to `value` with packing enabled; encoders are not run because deflate output differs between libraries. Optional "inflate": false compiles decoders without inflate (pack = false); omitted means inflate is enabled.
